परिचय / About

ज्यो. चेतन ओली

अध्यक्ष, नेपाल ज्योतिष परिषद्, झापा जिल्ला
President, Nepal Jyotish Parishad, Jhapa District

With more than 15 years of practice in Vedic astrology, Jyotish Chetan Oli has become one of the most trusted astrologers in eastern Nepal. He brings the classical knowledge of Jyotish together with a clear, practical way of explaining it, and has guided thousands of people through decisions about study, work, marriage and family.

As President of the Jhapa District branch of the Nepal Jyotish Parishad, he leads a community of astrologers working to preserve and share the knowledge of Jyotish.

“

To light the path of everyone who comes seeking guidance, using the lasting wisdom of the stars to bring clarity, peace and prosperity.
